about_the_game:
Poker Brawl "is a casual style strategy game in which players take on the role of a chess player, arrange their troops and strategize in a world where playing cards transform into heroes, and ultimately achieve the highest honor in the arena - the Arena Crown.

Poker Card Heroes

Each playing card corresponds to a unique hero with their own unique image and abilities. You can spend coins in battles to recruit them to fight for you! Three identical heroes can be upgraded to become stronger, and there are also mysterious and powerful size kings waiting for your recruitment!

Form card types to enhance your team's abilities

When the heroes in your team meet the activation criteria for a certain card type, that card type will activate and provide corresponding gains to all heroes who activate that card type. Reasonably building your team can activate multiple card types at the same time; The same flower sequence composed of all suits, bombs with four identical cards, or special card types that can only be composed of size kings, are all waiting for you to explore;

Choose a flash card to obtain powerful special effects

Every few rounds, you can choose one of the three flashcards to activate, and the activated flashcard will permanently take effect in this game. Whether to choose simple and effective attribute bonuses or increase the economic investment of coins, whether to choose complex effects required by special lineups or powerful effects that can change the gameplay, think patiently and make your own strategic choices!

Extract rewards and obtain unique decorations

By consuming currency, you can extract unique item rewards on the card drawing interface. Not only can you obtain various vivid and interesting expressions to express your emotions in battles, but you can also obtain rare chess players or chessboard skins to make your character and field stand out!
